status: non-executable designs only; nothing produced/tested/qualified/authorized; gate BLOCKED
common_constraints: worst-case only; closed vocabularies; no credentials/raw values/bodies/identities/document ids/unrelated records; no incident-derived material; stopped attempt != completed campaign; FAIL visible; redaction uncertainty => INCOMPLETE never pass; no broader-access retry; confirmed-failure branch split per stable artifact rules 4(a)/6 (safe => FAIL visible; leak-risk => withhold + INCOMPLETE)

packages.name: Read-path inventory
packages.purpose: Closed manifest of every input channel read by the method
packages.procedure: Enumerate read sites from interface + static read-path review; record surface, field, type and cardinality per channel; map each to a preapproved class; record unclassifiable reads
expected_evidence: source review record with file/line refs
packages.redaction_rules: field names/types/classes only; no server values
packages.failure_stop_conditions: unclassifiable read => UNKNOWN; incomplete read-set => INCOMPLETE; identity-bearing read => Q1 fails
packages.status_mapping: incomplete => INCOMPLETE; unclassifiable => UNKNOWN; confirmed identity channel => attempt INCOMPLETE
packages.qualification_criteria: design-level enumeration completeness accepted by independent technical review; no sampling claims

packages.name: Input value-domain proof
packages.purpose: Prove per-field that no identity-bearing value can enter
packages.procedure: Worst-case value-domain enumeration per field; classify as bounded/opaque/excluded; document that no free-text field, user/host/credential-bearing field, or server-generated identity-embedding string can enter
packages.redaction_rules: domain descriptors and class labels only; no example values
packages.failure_stop_conditions: free-text/identity field => stop; undetermined domain => INCOMPLETE; unrecognized field => UNKNOWN
packages.status_mapping: table incomplete => INCOMPLETE; unclassifiable domain => UNKNOWN
packages.qualification_criteria: worst-case coverage of every Q1 channel, independently reviewed

packages.name: Opaque-handle lifecycle proof
packages.purpose: Handles carry no identity and cannot resolve to a principal
packages.procedure: Document construction (non-principal), uniqueness scope (single assessment), resolvability analysis, lifecycle (creation, destruction at close, never carried across assessments)
packages.redaction_rules: opaque tokens only; no derivable attributes
packages.failure_stop_conditions: principal derivation/resolvability => stop; undocumented lifecycle => INCOMPLETE; conflicting evidence => FAIL where safe
packages.status_mapping: missing proof => INCOMPLETE; derivable => attempt INCOMPLETE; unresolvable uniqueness => UNKNOWN
packages.qualification_criteria: independent review confirms non-derivability and destruction-by-design

packages.name: Bounded adversarial negative-search
packages.purpose: Adversarial search for identity-encoding values or combinations
packages.procedure: Enumerate adversarial classes (incl. indirect identifiers); record outcomes and residual risk; withdraw unbounded classes
packages.redaction_rules: class outcomes/statuses only; discovered values never retained
packages.failure_stop_conditions: unbounded risk => withdraw class => Part 4 stop 1 INCOMPLETE; inconclusive => INCOMPLETE; discovered path => stop
packages.qualification_criteria: bounded residual risk per class reviewed; unbounded => withdrawn not waived

packages.name: No-passthrough proof
packages.purpose: Emitted outputs are label constants, never server-value transforms
packages.procedure: Map every emission site to a constant; analyze substring/transform paths; prove closed vocabulary
packages.redaction_rules: constants only; no observed values in the proof
packages.failure_stop_conditions: any passthrough => Q5 fails; unanalyzed site => INCOMPLETE
packages.status_mapping: unanalyzed => INCOMPLETE; confirmed passthrough => attempt INCOMPLETE; non-constant output => UNKNOWN

packages.name: Re-identification analysis
packages.purpose: Bound re-identification requirements from the output record
packages.procedure: Enumerate auxiliary categories; analyze joins/combinations; coarsen unjustified fields
packages.redaction_rules: category terms only; no auxiliary data collected
packages.failure_stop_conditions: unbounded risk => INCOMPLETE; undecidable coarsening => stop; unjustified field => drop
packages.status_mapping: unresolved risk => INCOMPLETE; undetermined category => UNKNOWN
packages.qualification_criteria: bounded risk under stated assumptions, independently reviewed

packages.name: Redaction-method qualification
packages.procedure: Worst-case predicate analysis; coarse-leak check design; adversarial test plan (no execution)
packages.redaction_rules: predicates/class outcomes only; no suppressed values
packages.failure_stop_conditions: uncertain redaction => INCOMPLETE; coarse leak path => stop; test execution without grant => prohibited
packages.status_mapping: uncertain => INCOMPLETE (never pass); missing analysis => INCOMPLETE; unclassifiable need => UNKNOWN
packages.qualification_criteria: worst-case analysis reviewed; test evidence outstanding until separately granted

packages.name: Independent package review
packages.purpose: Review Q1-Q7 under technical author/reviewer separation
packages.procedure: Structured review of completeness, consistency, boundaries, statuses; record disagreements; escalate rule-affecting issues
packages.failure_stop_conditions: blocking finding => package INCOMPLETE; rule disagreement => owner escalation (stop)
packages.status_mapping: review complete => eligible for Part 3 consideration only; missing review => INCOMPLETE
packages.qualification_criteria: technical separation only - not custody, not acceptance, not qualification
